titles.romaji: KINGSGLAIVE: FFXV Fan Kansha Tokubetsu Movie
titles.native: KINGSGLAIVE FFXV ファン感謝特別ムービー

description: A fan appreciation special movie release on Square Enix's official YouTube channel which indicated that Jan 1, 2017 will be the start of a collaboration with Final Fantasy: Brave Exvius, a mobile mmorpg launched in Japan over a year prior.
